emptyState.title: Publish your first post to start measuring
emptyState.body: Once a post goes out, Markaestro pulls its views, reach, and engagement from the platform within about an hour — and keeps tracking for 30 days. Follower counts are snapshotted daily for every connected channel.

page.warmingUp: Collecting metrics — the first snapshots arrive about an hour after publishing, then refresh on a decaying schedule for 30 days.

provenance.base: Metrics use each platform's API definitions and can lag native insights by up to 48 hours. A "—" means the platform doesn't provide that metric (for example, Threads and TikTok don't report reach). Engagement rate is engagements ÷ reach.
provenance.truncated: Post-level views are based on the {count} most recent posts in this window.

toasts.updated: {count, plural, one {Updated # post from source} other {Updated # posts from source}}
toasts.tooManyRefreshes: Too many refreshes — try again in a minute.
toasts.pullFailed: Couldn't pull live data. Showing the latest stored numbers.

contentTypeBars.publishAtLeastTwo: Publish at least two content formats (images, videos, carousels, text) to compare them.

trendChart.noData: No data for this period yet.
trendChart.followerHistoryBuilds: Follower history builds from daily snapshots — the trend appears after a couple of days of data.
